notes: No power-cycle was performed, so no Pi TFTP fetch was induced.

The deployed lab API exposes /status, /boot/files, /boot/archive, /boot/restore, and /tftp/logs, but no read-only endpoint that hashes or lists the actual dnsmasq-served root/cache independently of the API-visible boot tree.

helper_review_findings.finding: rpi5-proof-identity-join-v4-check does not accept API-visible /boot/files identity by itself.
helper_review_findings.evidence: Static inspection: scripts/rpi5-proof-identity-join-v4-check.sh requires same-power-cycle TFTP-served bytes, final pre-restore identity, restore proof, and serial freshness.

helper_review_findings.finding: The staging sentinel archive helper builds root and da591740/ copies with a no-MDIO/no-Ethernet/no-MMIO-target scenario.
helper_review_findings.evidence: Archive strings and post-publish /boot/files show da591740/kernel_2712.img at the archive byte count.

helper_review_findings.finding: Repository helpers cannot prove actual dnsmasq-served root/cache state without either a hardware fetch or a lab-service endpoint exposing that serving root.
helper_review_findings.evidence: No-power /tftp/logs delta after publish had zero events; lab-controller docs expose logs but not live served-root hashing.

acceptance.next_mechanically_valid_path: lab-service blocker requiring Matthew/operator input: expose or repair a read-only lab API check of the actual dnsmasq-served TFTP root/cache, or authorize operator-level inspection; do not retry MDIO/register-vector hardware from API-visible identity alone.
